caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden spade centered on a plain, light beige background. The spade has a D-shaped handle at the top, a straight shaft, and a rectangular blade. The wood is rendered in shades of brown with visible grain patterns, knots, and areas of darker and lighter coloring, giving it a textured, natural appearance. The handle, shaft, and blade are presented in a vertical alignment, occupying most of the vertical space in the composition. Beneath the image of the spade, the name "Eugène Bartz" is written in a small, simple typeface. No other objects or elements are present in the image.
title: Toy Shovel
